tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor du bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i cho ga bklags pas grub par bkod pa rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// rje btsun dam pa yon tan ye shes dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi pad+mo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'og min gnas su sangs rgyas kyi// gsang ba thob pa'i snang ba'i gzi// lcang lo can du 'khyil ba'i dpal// gos sngon tshogs kyi thig ler 'dud// gang de bsnyen dang sgrub pa dang*// sgrub pa chen po'i yi ge'i ris// grub thob rnams kyis bshad pa'i kha// bla ma'i zhal gyis bkang ste bshad// 'dir rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rig sngags kyi sgo'i spyad pa spyod par 'dod pas/ dbang dang dam tshig thob cing yon tan dang ldan pas 'khor bzang po dang lhan cig tu gnas legs par dus dge ba la maṇ+ḍal dang bum pa sogs bcas te yo byad dang ldan pas bsgrub par bya'o// cho ga gang gis bsgrub pa zhe na/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud las/ dang po khrus byas rnal 'byor pas// bde ba'i gdan la gnas nas ni// mchod dang gsol bas lha drug bsgom// stong dang sgra dang yig gzugs dang*// phyag rgya mtshan ma drug yin te// bum par bskyed sogs rdzogs byas la// nor bu spyod lam sngags bzlas te// sha la sogs pa bdun spang ngo*// zhes gsungs pas gtsang sbra bya ba ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ mahā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa// ces lan bdun la sogs par bsngags pa'i chu la khrus byas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces chu snyim pa gsum spyi bor blug /de nas rang nyid las thams cad pa'i khro bo shin tu 'jigs pa ljang kha/ phyag gnyis bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya can/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan te/ g.yon brkyang bas nyi ma la bzhugs par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas khro bo'i tshogs spros pas gnas kyi bgegs bskrad par bsam/ hūm̐ hūm̐ 'gro ba 'dzin pa yis ni byas zin gyis// hūm̐ hūm̐ gdug pa'i yid can gang yin pha tshad song*// hūm̐ hūm̐ khro bo'i rgyal po sdang mig 'bar ba yis// hūm̐ hūm̐ bsregs nas thal ba bzhin du byas ta re// shar phyogs nas ni char chen 'bab// me phyogs glo bur snang ba byung*// gshin rje 'chi bdag gzugs su byung*// bden bral sems can la 'jigs byed// chu phyogs gshin rje 'brug sgra sgrog

/rlung gi phyogs nas 'tshub ma 'byung*// gnod sbyin pho mo byang phyogs gnas// dbang ldan phyogs nas sna tshogs gzugs// steng nas mthu chen lha rnams dang*// 'og nas sa 'gas g.yo byed pa// gang dag mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// bgegs rnams thams cad 'gro bar gyis// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ṭa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃ ṣ+ṭoṭ+ka ṭa bhai ra wa ra ya/ a si mu pa la dha ra ya/ pa ra shu pā sho hasta ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ gardza gardza/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nan bi na ma hā ga na pa ti/ dzi wa ta an+ta ka ra ya swā hā/ zhes bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring po'i mthar/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa tro ṭa/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ ghūr+ṇā ghūr+ṇā/ ghūr+ṇā pa ya ghūr+ṇā pa ya/ sarba satwā ni/ bho dha bho dha/ saṃ bho dha ya saṃ bho dha ya/ bh+rā ma bh+rā ma/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya saṃ bh+rā ma ya/ sarba bhū tā ni/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya/ sa rba shatrūn/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha ṭa ya/ gnod byed 'byung po ma ra ya phaṭa/ ces btags pa'i sngags 'don zhing thun gyis brab/ rol mo dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad cing sngags dang bcas pa'i chus sa phyogs bsang gtor bya'o// de nas bde ba'i gdan la rdo rje'i skyil mo krung ngam sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste/ dus 'di nas gzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung khungs/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas=

chos= dge 'dun= bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chu bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis bsnyen bsgrub bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog / ces lan gsum bya// mchod dang zhes pas/ rang nyid las thams cad pa'i khro bo shin tu 'jigs pa ljang kha/ phyag gnyis bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya can/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan te/ g.yon brkyang bas nyi ma la bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer kyis/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par 'joms pa rdo rje khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun kyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par mos la/ rdo rje dang bcas pas ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya g.yab cing*/ dril bu 'khrol dbyangs snyan pos/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs rje can gyi thabs chen gyi// zhi yang sems can don du ni// dri ma med pa'i khro bor gyur// stobs po che la drag shul che// rig sngags rgyal po dge ba can// 'dul dka' ba dag 'dul ba po// rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das// rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor che// ma rungs pa rnams 'joms slad du// dad pas spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs la// bdag las mchod pa bzhes su gsol// na mo tsur kun+dha tsur kun+dha/ badz+ra pā ṇi bud+dha s+ya badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ nam mkhar byon pa la/ oṃ pra wa ra sat+ka rā pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil phul/ puṣ+pa ma le swā hā/ me tog gi gdan phul/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lha'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// gdug pa tshar gcod khro bo'i sku// rdo rje chen po 'jigs chen po// rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces phyag 'tshal/ /lha mo zla ba ltar dkar gzugs// mtshar sdug lang tshos snyems pa'i gar// me tog 'phreng bas sgrib zol gyis// mtho ris 'dun sa bzhin du mchod// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa// lha mo gnam ga ltar mthing gzugs// dri zhim ngad pa 'thul ba'i gar// bdug spos 'phreng bas=

mtho ris= dhū pe= lha mo mtshams sprin ltar dmar gzugs// nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od 'phro'i gar// mar me'i 'phreng= mtho ris= ā lo ke= lha mo mar gad ltar ljang gzugs// reg pas sim byed byug pa'i gar// dri chab 'phreng= mtho ris= gan+dhe= lha mo gser ltar ser ba'i gzugs// ma mchu'i ro brgya mngar ba'i gar// zhal zas phreng= mtho ris= nai wi d+yā= lha mo baiḍūr ltar sngo gzugs// snyan 'gyur glu sgra sgrog pa'i gar// rol mo'i 'phreng bas= mtho ris= shap+ta= zhes sngags dang phyag rgya dang*// yid dang dngos su 'byor ba'i mchod pa bzhis mchod de/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ /badz+ra muḥ tshogs zhing rang gnas su gshegs/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /sems can thams cad nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i gtang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig / lan gsum/ gsol bas zhes pa/ bdud 'dul ba'i rgyal ba'i dbang po zas gtsang gi sras mdun gyi nam mkhar dzaḥ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi lus rdo rjer byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ lha drug bsgom zhes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus bdag gi lus thams cad rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs nas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dhārmāḥswabhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/

stong pa nyid kyi lha/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes de las kun rdzob tu snang ba/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā nā ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa ya tro ṭa ya/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ ghūr+ṇā ghūr+ṇā/ ghūr+ṇā pa ya ghūr+ṇa pa ya// sarba satwā ni/ bho dha bho dha/ saṃ bho dha ya saṃ bho dha ya/ bh+rā ma bh+rā ma/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya saṃ bh+rā ma ya/ sarba bhū tā ni/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya/ sarba sha trūn/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba bīd+yaṃ badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa nī la badz+ra su badz+ra ya swā hā/ he phul+lu/ ni ru phul+lu/ gṛ h+na kul+lu/ mi li tsul+lu/ ku ru kul+lu/ badz+ra bi dza yā swā hā/ kī lī kī lā ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na/ pra mo ṭa nā ya swā hā/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya/ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇā ya swā hā/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ ma hā kī li kī la ya swā hā// bhan+dha bhan+dha/ kro dha badz+ra kī lī kī la ya swā hā/ tsu ru tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ trā sa ya/ trā sa ya/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhañdza nā ya swā hā/ ma tis+thi ra badz+ra/ shū tis+thi ra badz+ra/ pra tis+thi ra badz+ra/ ma hā badz+ra// a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra dhā rā ya swā hā/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ sarba badz+ra ku laṃ ā warta ya swā hā/ gnod byed 'byung po grib gdon thams cad mā ra ya phaṭaḥ na ma saman+ta badz+ra ṇaṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku la mā warta ya/ ma hā ba le/ ka ṭa be/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍal ma ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra na ra na/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ting ga le/ da ha da ha/ te dz+wa ba ti/

ti li ti li/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ma hā ba le badz+ra aṃ ku sha dz+wa lā ya swā hā/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya// na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha ra ha ra badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra// dha ra dha ra badz+ra// dhā ra ya dhā ra ya badz+ra// dā ru ṇa dā ru ṇa badz+ra/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha badz+ra/ bhin+dha bhin+dha badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ gzungs ring tshar gcig /rig byed kyi sgra'i tshul du grags pa sgra'i lha'o// de nas/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pas/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba zlum po la rdo rje mda'i dra bas brgyan pa/ bar mtshams med pa cis kyang mi tshugs cis kyang ma shigs cis kyang mi 'jig pa'i rdo rje'i mkhar me'i phung por 'bar ba nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i nang du bh+rūṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzhal yas khang rdo rje rin po che'i rgyal po dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba las grub pa gru bzhi pa rmang gi phyir 'dod pa'i lha mo gnas pa'i pad+ma rā ga'i snam bu dang*// ba gam 'dzam bu na dī ha ra nag po'i steng gi gser gdung las mu tig dkar dmar gyi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ rgya phubs kyi lcam sna las 'thur du in+d+ra nī la'i shar bu dang*/ bad kyi thad dang mnyam pa'i steng du karke ta'i mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang gdugs ba dan rnam pa mang pos mdzes pa/ thogs 'phar ma gsum brtsegs kyi dbus 'phyur bu rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan cing*/ sgo bzhi'i sgo khyud twa ra ṇa bzhis spras pa'i rtser/ gdugs kyis phub pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa pad+ma la gnas pa'i ri dwags zung mig mi 'dzum par lta ba/

'bar ba/ bkra ba/ lta na sdug pa/ rnam par phye ba/ phyi nas bltas na nang gsal zhing nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba rgya dang khyon blos mi 'khyud pa'i nang du gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ me'i tshwa tshwa zhun mar 'phro ba/ lte ba'i nang du rdo rje pha lam las grub pa rtse mo gcig pa'i rdo rje'i rgya gram/ khong seng can gyi lte bar chos 'byung dmar po'i nang du zla ba dang nyi ma/ ra dang rtsibs rnams la nyi gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ dbugs kyi hūm̐ nag po yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa mthing shun dri ma med pa'i kha dog lta bu lte bar zla ba la gzungs sngags kyi yi ge hraṃ mer snang ba/ yi ge'i lha'o/ /de las rnam par 'joms pa'i sku sna la bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin nam mkha' khyab par gang bas 'phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad/ 'phags pa rnams mchod cing nus mthu bsdus te zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag /drag shul chen po'i byin gyis sgeg pa/ gsus khyim che zhing*/ nywa sul rags pa/ gnam sa tsam du gdangs pa'i khro bo'i zhal nas/ khams gsum za bar byed pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags bsgril nas rkan sgra brdabs pas srid pa gsum g.yo zhing bsgul ba/ ag tshom mer dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i khrod nas rdo rje'i stag 'phro ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung 'tshub cing smin ma 'khyogs po las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ rdo rje'i thod nyis rim du bcings pa'i ral pa dmar ser gyen du gzings pa rta gdong gi ri langs pa lta bu/ phyag g.yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyi rdo rje ma rungs pa'i snying la gsor zhing*/ g.yon 'gying bag dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/

sbrul chen po rigs lngas rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang se ral kha dang do shal dang*/ gdub bu byas pa/ dar sngon pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs kyis smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i brjid kyis nyin mor byed pa brdzis te sku las mched pa'i me dang mi bzad pa'i du ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rdo rje'i rwa'i hūm̐ las/ shar du sku'i khro bo rdo rje gtum po gangs kyi dum bu chad pa lta bur dkar ba zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ lhor yon tan kyi khro bo rdo rje be con gser kyi ri'i ngos lta bur ser ba nga rgyal rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ nub tu gsung gi khro bo rdo rje tho ba nyi ma 'char ka'i mthongs lta bur dmar ba 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ byang du 'phrin las kyi khro bo rdo rje phur pa mar gad kyi zhun lta bur ljang ba phrag dog rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ thams cad phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ gtum pa chen po zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum 'bar ba/ 'jigs su rung zhing gel la brjid pa/ ral pa gshor po sbrul gyi rgyan dang*/ dar gyi lhub gon dang*/ stag sham gyis spras te g.yas brkyang bas tsha zer can la bzhugs pa me'i pa ṭas bskor ba/ rtsibs bcu'i hūm̐ las/ shar du khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba dkar po/ lhor khro bo gshin rje gshed ser po/ nub tu khro bo rta mgrin dmar po// byang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu// shar lhor khro bo dbyug sngon can dkar po/ lho nub tu khro bo gshin rje mthar byed ser po/ nub byang du khro bo mi g.yo ba dmar po/ byang shar du khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa ljang kha/ steng du khro bo hūm̐ mdzad mthing kha/ 'og tu khro bo stobs po che nag po/ thams cad kyang phyag gnyis rdo rje phur pa stod khro bo/

bar rdo rje rgya mdud/ smad chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i dbal gsum mer 'bar ba bsgril zhing*/ khro la 'khrugs pa'i zhal yas kyi mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ spyan gsum khrag tu 'khol zhing gzir ba dpa' zhing sgeg pa mi sdug pa'i sku/ sbrul gyi rgyan dang stag sham can/ g.yas brkyang bas me'i phung po chen po'i khrod du nyi ma la bzhugs pa/

gzugs kyi lha'o// sor mo bsnol ba 'khor lo'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs te/ shru tis+thi ra badz+ra oṃ/ spyi bor pad+ma'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rdo rje thal mo la mdzub mo'i rtse sbyar ba pad+ma'i phyag rgya mgrin pa ra gtugs te/ pra tis+thi ra badz+ra āḥ mgrin par nyi ma'i steng du pad+ma dmar po āḥmatshan pa/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying khar gtugs te/ ma tis+thi ra badz+ra hūm̐/ snying khar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje mthing kha lte bar zla ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i phyag rgyas skye mched rnams la reg cing*/ mahā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas/ mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus la zla ba la rdo rje/ snying kha'i sa bon gyi mthar gzungs sngags kyis bskor ba in+d+ra nī la'i 'phreng ba 'khyil ba lta bu las 'od 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par 'joms pa rdo rje khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par mos la/ sngar bshad pa'i phyag rgyas/ e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ sogs nas/ shap+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mchod pa rdzogs pa'i bar tshogs zhing bzhin la// bstod pa ni/ rdo rje'i ri dang in+d+ra nī la yi// chu gter 'khrugs pas rba rlabs langs pa ltar// rngam pa'i sku ni dpa' ba'i byin ci yang*// 'khrigs pa 'bar bas brjid la phyag 'tshal bstod// gnam sa'i khyad tsam gdangs pa'i khro zhal gyi// mche bas bdud bzhi zos pa'i khrag bcas ljags// gyen du 'dril ba drag po'i hūm̐ sgra yis// khams gsum srid pa 'gul la phyag 'tshal bstod// khro gnyer gyis bcings shang nas g.yos pa'i rlung*// ma rungs sder bcas srog gi mthar byed nges// cung zad ma bsgul sma ra'i pa ṭa las// rdo rje'i me stag 'phro la phyag 'tshal bstod// dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig gzir ba'i steng*// smin 'khyog me dpung 'bar ba'i drag shul gyis// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams dngangs pa mi bzad pa'i// mun pas 'thums par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// ral pa'i thun mtshams sprin gsar la khro ba'i// gdengs can bdag po phud sgra'i nga ro can// 'khyog por bgrod pa'i rgyan gyis brjid pa'i bag

/blo yi ra ba 'gongs la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal ba'i mthu stobs rdo rje gzir ba'i shugs// khams gsum bdag po'i srog gis ma bzod pa// slar yang thugs rje'i byin gyis dbugs dbyung ba'i// brda tsam dril bus mtshon la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yas bskum g.yon pa brkyang ba'i stang stabs kyis// nyin mor byed pa lham lhum brdzis pa'i zer// phyogs bcur 'khyar la gnag pa dud pa'i sprin// khol mas 'gegs par 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku yi khro bo rnam par rgyal ba gang*// mche gtsigs rdo rje gtum po'i drag shul gyis// dri za'i gdon 'joms zhe sdang rnam dag pas// 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// yon tan khro bo 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed// rdo rje bai con can ni drag shul gyis// gshis rje'i gdon 'joms nga rgyal rnam dag pas// 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsung gi khro bo rta mchog he ru ka /brtan pa rdo rje tho ba drag shul gyis// klu yi gdon 'joms 'dod chags rnam dag pas// 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'phrin las khro bo don yod brtan pa'i dpal// rdo rje phur pa chen po drag shul gyis// gnod sbyin gdon 'joms phrag dog rnam dag pas// 'jigs byed 'jigs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ mdzad rnam par rgyal dang gshin rje'i dgra// rta mchog bdud rtsi khyil ba khro bo'i dbang*// mi bzad gtum pa hūm̐ gi nga ro can// bgegs dpung mtshon chas gtub la phyag 'tshal bstod// stobs chen dbyugs sngon gshin rje mthar byed dang*// mi g.yo gzhan gyis mi thub gtum po rnams// khros 'khrugs rngam pa'i ngar skad ci yang bcas// bstan pa'i dgra bo sgrol la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha hūm̐ḥbadz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃḥbadz+ra ā be sha ya a/

dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mos// na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku laṃ āwarta ya/ mahā ba le/ ka ṭa we/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ping ga le/ da ha da ha/ te dzo wa ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i glu len cing gser gyi bum pa spyi bor bkod nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chus dbang bskur/ dri ma dag lus thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ chu rgyun lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la rnam par 'joms pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thal mo lhan cig dam du sbyar te pad+ma'i tshul du bgyis pa la mdzub mo nor bur bgyis te gung mo yid tsam bkug pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i phyag rgya ste spyi bor gtugs nas dbang bskur ba'i sngags 'di brjod do// sarba bid+yaṃ badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa nī la badz+ra/ su badz+ra ya swā hā/ 'dis dbang bskur ba tsam gyis rigs sngags thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro/ phyag rgya'i lha'o// ji skad bshad pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa la rtse gcig tu dmigs te yang yang du bsgom pa mtshan ma'i lha ste/ de ltar lha drug go /bsgom pas dub na bzlas brjod la 'jug ste/ ru rāk+ṣām rus pa'i 'phreng ba la bsang gtor byas/ oṃ badz+ra a dzi ta ye swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ snying kha'i sngags 'phreng las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/

rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ thams cad kyis gzungs sngags 'brug gi sgra ltar du zlos par bsams la mdo sde bzhin du gzungs ring dang*/ na mash+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭaḥ cesagazungs thung gang 'grub bzlas so// yang na 'di nyid kyi bshad pa'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor bsnyen pa gsum du bya// las la gnyis te las grub gsum// gtso dang 'khor dang 'dus pa ni/ las bzhi sngags sogs dbye bar bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar du/ khro bo'i ngag gam shub bu'i sbyor bas 'bum phrag gsum bzlas so// de ltar bzlas pa'i dus// lus kyi nyes pa ni lces sngags zlos mi nus pa dang*// lag pas phyag rgya bcing mi nus pa dang*// rkang pas skyil krung mi nus pa dang*// mig gis sku gzugs dang mchod rten dang*/ lha la blta bar mi nus pa dang*/ ngag gi nyes pa rdzun dang phrag dang*/ ngag 'khyal pa dang*/ tshig rtsub po la dga' ba dang*/ sems kyi nyes pa bzlas brjod byed pa'i tshe khro ba dang*/ 'dod yon lnga la chags pa che ba dang*/ zhum pa dang mi dga' ba dang*/ 'jigs pa dang 'dzums pa dang*/ rig sngags zlos pa'i tshe/ sbrid pa dang lud pa dang*/ gtam gyis bar chod pa'i tshe nye reg byas nas phyag 'tshal te/ gzhi nas bzlas brjod brtsam mo// dus ni lo gcig gam zla ba drug tu'o// mtshan ma ni dngos dang nyams dang rmi lam du/ lus la me 'bar ba dang*/ srog chags 'thon pa dang*/ gos sngon po gyon pa dang*/ lha mjal ba la sogs so// de ni lha bskul ba'i bsnyen pa ste dang po'o// de nas bum pa dang sbyin sreg dang*/ rdul tshon la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ zhi ba la 'o ma/ rgyas pa la 'gi'u wang*/ dbang la mtshal/ drag po la dug khrag la sogs rdzas bkod la sngags kyi gnad dang ldan pas bdag dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa'i 'phro 'du la dmigs te bum chu 'khol zhing lud pa dang*/

'khor lo dang dkyil 'khor bkrag dang ldan pa dang*/ rdzas gzhas dro ba dang 'bar ba dang du bar 'thul ba dang rngul ba la sogs pa'i rtags ma byung bar du bsnyen pas bsnyen pa'i tshul drug go// de nas gtor ma 'bul zhing rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang dang*/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam btab/ bum pa sogs rdzas la gos gtsang ma bkab/ phreng ba la bcol/ ci bde bar spyod lam la 'jug go// bsnyen pa'i yi ge rdzogs so/ ༈ de nas bum bskyed ni/ stegs bu gtsang ma'i khar bum pa bcu gnyis sam lnga sogs rdzas dang ldan pa sta gon skabs su bshad pa ltar bshams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gi nang du baṃ las rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po'i steng du ā las byung ba'i zla ba la gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ me'i tshwa tshwa zhun mar 'phro ba/ lte ba'i nang du rdo rje pha lam las grub pa rtse mo gcig pa'i rdo rje'i rgya gram/ khong seng can gyi lte bar chos 'byung dmar po'i nang du zla ba dang nyi ma/ ra dang rtsibs rnams la nyi gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ dbus kyi hūm̐ nag po yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa mthing shun dri ma med pa'i kha dog lta bu lte bar zla ba la gzungs sngags kyi yi ge hraṃ mer snang ba/ yi ge'i lha'o/ /de las rnam par 'joms pa'i sku sna la bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin nam mkha' khyab par gang bas 'phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad/ 'phags pa rnams mchod cing nus mthu bsdus te zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag /drag shul chen po'i byin gyis sgeg pa/ gsus khyim che zhing*/

nywa sul rags pa/ gnam sa tsam du gdangs pa'i khro bo'i zhal nas/ khams gsum za bar byed pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags bsgril nas rkan sgra brdabs pas srid pa gsum g.yo zhing bsgul ba/ ag tshom mer dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i khrod nas rdo rje'i me stag 'phro ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung 'tshub cing smin ma 'khyogs po las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ rdo rje'i thod nyis rim du bcings pa'i ral pa dmar ser gyen du gzings pa rta gdong gi ri langs pa lta bu/ phyag g.yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyi rdo rje ma rungs pa'i snying la gsor zhing*/ g.yon 'gying bag dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ sbrul chen po rigs lngas rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang se ral kha dang do shal dang*/ gdub byas pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs kyis smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i brjid kyis nyin mor byed pa brdzis te sku las mched pa'i me dang mi bzad pa'i dud pa 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rdo rje'i rwa'i hūm̐ las/ shar du sku'i khro bo rdo rje gtum po gangs kyi dum bu chad pa lta bur dkar ba zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ lhor yon tan kyi khro bo rdo rje be con gser kyi ri'i ngos lta bur ser ba nga rgyal rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ nub tu gsung gi khro bo rdo rje tho ba nyi ma 'char ka'i mthongs lta bur dmar ba 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ byang du 'phrin las kyi khro bo rdo rje phur pa mar gad kyi zhun lta bur ljang ba phrag dog rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ thams cad phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ gtum pa chen po zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum 'bar ba/ 'jigs su rung zhing gel la brjid pa/

ral pa gshor po sbrul gyi rgyan dang*/ dar gyi lhub gon dang*/ stag sham gyis spras te g.yas brkyang bas tsha zer can la bzhugs pa me'i pa ṭas bskor ba/ rtsibs bcu'i hūm̐ las/ shar du khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba dkar po/ lhor khro bo gshin rje gshed ser po/ nub tu khro bo rta mgrin dmar po// byang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu// shar lhor khro bo dbyug sngon can dkar po/ lho nub tu khro bo gshin rje mthar byed ser po/ nub byang du khro bo mi g.yo ba dmar po/ byang shar du khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa ljang kha/ steng du khro bo hūm̐ mdzad mthing kha/ 'og tu khro bo stobs po che nag po/ thams cad kyang phyag gnyis rdo rje phur pa stod khro bo/ bar rdo rje rgya mdud/ smad chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i dbal gsum mer 'bar ba bsgril zhing*/ khro la 'khrugs pa'i zhal yas kyi mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ spyan gsum khrag tu 'khol zhing gzir ba dpa' zhing sgeg pa mi sdug pa'i sku/ sbrul gyi rgyan dang stag sham can/ g.yas brkyang bas me'i phung po chen po'i khrod du nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ las bum du hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i pad zla la las thams cad pa'i khro bo shin tu 'jigs pa ljang kha phyag gnyis bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya can/ klu brgyad kyis brgyan te g.yon brkyang bas nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ shru tis+thi ra badz+ra oṃ/ spyi bor pad+ma'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rdo rje thal mo la mdzub mo'i rtse sbyar ba pad+ma'i phyag rgya mgrin par gtugs te/ pra tis+thi ra badz+ra āḥ mgrin par nyi ma'i steng du pad+ma dmar po āḥmatshan pa/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying khar gtugs te/ ma tis+thi ra badz+ra hūm̐/ snying khar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje mthing kha lte bar zla ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i phyag rgyas skye mched rnams la reg cing*/ mahā badz+ra/

a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas/ mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus la zla ba la rdo rje/ snying kha'i sa bon gyi mthar gzungs sngags kyis bskor ba in+d+ra nī la'i 'phreng ba 'khyil ba lta bu las 'od 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par 'joms pa rdo rje khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs rje can gyi thabs chen gyi// zhi yang sems can don du ni// dri ma med pa'i khro bor gyur// stobs po che la drag shul che// rig sngags rgyal po dge ba can// 'dul dka' ba dag 'dul ba po// rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das// rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor che// ma rungs pa rnams 'joms slad du// dad pas spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs la// bdag las mchod pa bzhes su gsol// na mo tsur kun+dha tsur kun+dha/ badz+ra pā ṇi bud+dha s+ya badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ nam mkhar byon pa la/ oṃ pra wa ra sat+ka rā pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil phul/ puṣ+pa ma le swā hā/ me tog gi gdan phul/

oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lha'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha hūm̐ḥbadz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃḥbadz+ra ā be sha ya a/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mos// na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku laṃ āwarta ya/ mahā ba le/ ka ta we/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ping ga le/ da ha da ha/ te dzo wa ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i glu len cing gser gyi bum pa spyi bor bkod nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chus dbang bskur/ dri ma dag lus thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ chu rgyun lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la rnam par 'joms pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thal mo lhan cig dam du sbyar te pad+ma'i tshul du bgyis pa la mdzub mo nor bur bgyis te gung mo yid tsam bkug pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i phyag rgya ste spyi bor gtugs nas dbang bskur ba'i sngags 'di brjod do/ /sarba bid+yaṃ badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa nī la badz+ra/ su badz+ra ya swā hā/ 'dis dbang bskur ba tsam gyis rigs sngags thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro// chu bo gaṅgā'i rgyun bzhin du// mchod yon rgyun yang mi 'chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i mchod yon 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dar s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

me tog pad+ma'i tshal bzhin du// me tog rgyun yang mi 'chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i me tog 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la 'bul// 'gro ba'i= puṣ+pe= tsan+dan sdong po'i dri bzhin du// bdug spos rgyun yang mi 'chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i bdug spos 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i= 'gro ba'i= dhū pe= nyi zla nor bu'i 'od bzhin du// snang gsal rgyun yang mi 'chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i snang gsal 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i= 'gro ba'i= a lo ke= hu lun ka yi dri bzhin du// dri chab rgyun yang mi 'chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i dri chab 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i= 'gro ba'i= gan+dhe= so rtsi ka yi ro bzhin du// ro mchog rgyun yang mi 'chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i ro mchog 'di// bcom ldan bum pa'i= 'gro ba'i= nai wīd+ya= pi waṃ gling bu'i sgra bzhin du// sgra snyan rgyun yang mi 'chad pa'i// lha rdzas bzang po'i sgra snyan 'di// bcom ldan= 'gro ba'i= shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ ces mchod la/ bcom ldan mgon po rdo rje 'dzin// khyod ni bzang po'i bzhin dang ldan// khyod ni rnam par gnon pa po// khyod ni glang po'i rna ba can// yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas khyod// khyod ni bden pa'i sprin yin te// khyod ni gzugs sdug yid kyi rgyan// khyod ni me lce 'bar ba can// yid bzhin nor nyid gzugs mdzes sku// bcom ldan rdo rje rnams 'joms ni// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// drag po'i phrin las ma lus pa// sgrub par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ de nas gzungs thag blangs te sngags khro bo'i ngag tu bzlas dus/ sngags phreng gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar thim par gyur/

gzungs ring dang gzungs thung gang 'grub bzlas/ las bum la dmigs te/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ṭa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃ ṣ+ṭoṭ+ka ṭa bhai ra wa ra ya/ a si mu pa la dha ra ya/ pa ra shu pā sho hasta ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ gardza gardza/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nan bi na ma hā ga na pa ti/ dzi wa ta an+ta ka ra ya swā hā/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ mthar lha 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam pa ste bum bskyed do// ༈ de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa la/ oṃ badz+ra dṛ ṣ+ṭa ma ṭa/ dkyil 'khor chen po skad cig gis nam mkha' la 'phags par gyur/ sgrub mchod kyi skabs nyin gnyis pa nas dkyil 'khor 'degs/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsang gtor byas/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba zlum po la rdo rje mda'i dra bas brgyan pa/ bar mtshams med pa cis kyang mi tshugs cis kyang ma shigs cis kyang mi 'jig pa'i rdo rje'i mkhar me'i phung por 'bar ba nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i nang du bh+rūṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzhal yas khang rdo rje rin po che'i rgyal po dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba las grub pa gru bzhi pa rmang gi phyir 'dod pa'i lha mo gnas pa'i pad+ma rā ga'i snam bu dang*// ba gam 'dzam bu na dī ha ra nag po'i steng gi gser gdung las mu tig dkar dmar gyi dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/

rgya phubs kyi lcam sna las 'thur du in+d+ra nī la'i shar bu dang*/ bad kyi thad dang mnyam pa'i steng du karke ta'i mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang gdugs ba dan rnam pa mang pos mdzes pa/ thog 'phar ma gsum brtsegs kyi dbus 'phyur bu rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis brgyan cing*/ sgo bzhi'i sgo khyud twa ra ṇa bzhis spras pa'i rtser/ gdugs kyis phub pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa pad+ma la gnas pa'i ri dwags zung mig mi 'dzum par lta ba/ 'bar ba/ bkra ba/ lta na sdug pa/ rnam par phye ba/ phyi nas bltas na nang gsal zhing nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba rgya dang khyon blos mi 'khyud pa'i nang du gnam lcags 'bar ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ me'i tshwa tshwa zhun mar 'phro ba/ lte ba'i nang du rdo rje pha lam las grub pa rtse mo gcig pa'i rdo rje'i rgya gram/ khong seng can gyi lte bar chos 'byung dmar po'i nang du zla ba dang nyi ma/ ra dang rtsibs rnams la nyi gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ dbus kyi hūm̐ nag po yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa mthing shun dri ma med pa'i kha dog lta bu lte bar zla ba la gzungs sngags kyi yi ge hraṃ mer snang ba/ yi ge'i lha'o/ /de las rnam par 'joms pa'i sku sna la bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin nam mkha' khyab par gang bas 'phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad/ 'phags pa rnams mchod cing nus mthu bsdus te zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag /drag shul chen po'i byin gyis sgeg pa/ gsus khyim che zhing*/ nywa sul rags pa/ gnam sa tsam du gdangs pa'i khro bo'i zhal nas/ khams gsum za bar byed pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags bsgril nas rkan sgra brdabs pas srid pa gsum g.yo zhing bsgul ba/

ag tshom mer dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i khrod nas rdo rje'i me stag 'phro ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung 'tshub cing smin ma 'khyogs po las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ rdo rje'i thod nyis rim du bcings pa'i ral pa dmar ser gyen du gzings pa rta gdong gi ri langs pa lta bu/ phyag g.yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyi rdo rje ma rungs pa'i snying la gsor zhing*/ g.yon 'gying bag dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ sbrul chen po rigs lngas rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang se ral kha dang do shal dang*/ gdub bu byas pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs kyis smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i brjid kyis nyin mor byed pa brdzis te sku las mched pa'i me dang mi bzad pa'i dud pa 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ rdo rje'i rwa'i hūm̐ las/ shar du sku'i khro bo rdo rje gtum po gangs kyi dum bu chad pa lta bur dkar ba zhe sdang rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ lhor yon tan kyi khro bo rdo rje be con gser kyi ri'i ngos lta bur ser ba nga rgyal rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ nub tu gsung gi khro bo rdo rje tho ba nyi ma 'char ka'i mthongs lta bur dmar ba 'dod chags rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ byang du 'phrin las kyi khro bo rdo rje phur pa mar gad kyi zhun lta bur ljang ba phrag dog rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid can/ thams cad phyag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ gtum pa chen po zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum 'bar ba/ 'jigs su rung zhing gel la brjid pa/ ral pa gshor po sbrul gyi rgyan dang*/ dar gyi lhub gon dang*/ stag sham gyis spras te g.yas brkyang bas tsha zer can la bzhugs pa me'i pa ṭas bskor ba/ rtsibs bcu'i hūm̐ las/

shar du khro bo khams gsum rnam par rgyal ba dkar po/ lhor khro bo gshin rje gshed ser po/ nub tu khro bo rta mgrin dmar po// byang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang khu// shar lhor khro bo dbyug sngon can dkar po/ lho nub tu khro bo gshin rje mthar byed ser po/ nub byang du khro bo mi g.yo ba dmar po/ byang shar du khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa ljang kha/ steng du khro bo hūm̐ mdzad mthing kha/ 'og tu khro bo stobs po che nag po/ thams cad kyang phyag gnyis rdo rje phur pa stod khro bo/ bar rdo rje rgya mdud/ smad chu srin gyi kha nas 'phyang ba'i dbal gsum mer 'bar ba bsgril zhing*/ khro la 'khrugs pa'i zhal g.yas kyi mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ spyan gsum khrag tu 'khol zhing gzir ba dpa' zhing sgeg pa mi sdug pa'i sku/ sbrul gyi rgyan dang stag sham can/ g.yas brkyang bas me'i phung po chen po'i khrod du nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ gzugs kyi lha'o// sor mo bsnol ba 'khor lo'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs te/ shru tis+thi ra badz+ra oṃ/ spyi bor pad+ma'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ rdo rje thal mo la mdzub mo'i rtse sbyar ba pad+ma'i phyag rgya mgrin pa ra gtugs te/ pra tis+thi ra badz+ra āḥ mgrin par nyi ma'i steng du pad+ma dmar po āḥmatshan pa/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying khar gtugs te/ ma tis+thi ra badz+ra hūm̐/ snying khar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje mthing kha lte bar zla ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i phyag rgyas skye mched rnams la reg cing*/ mahā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas/ mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus la zla ba la rdo rje/ snying kha'i sa bon gyi mthar gzungs sngags kyis bskor ba in+d+ra nī la'i 'phreng ba 'khyil ba lta bu las 'od 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par 'joms pa rdo rje khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs

par mos la/ sngar bshad pa'i phyag rgyas/ e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs rje can gyi thabs chen gyi// zhi yang sems can don du ni// dri ma med pa'i khro bor gyur// stobs po che la drag shul che// rig sngags rgyal po dge ba can// 'dul dka' ba dag 'dul ba po// rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das// rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor che// ma rungs pa rnams 'joms slad du// dad pas spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs la// bdag las mchod pa bzhes su gsol// na mo tsur kun+dha tsur kun+dha/ badz+ra pā ṇi bud+dha s+ya badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ nam mkhar byon pa la/ oṃ pra wa ra sat+ka rā pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas zhabs bsil phul/ puṣ+pa ma le swā hā/ me tog gi gdan phul/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lha'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha hūm̐ḥbadz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃḥbadz+ra ā be sha ya a/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mos// na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku laṃ āwarta ya/ mahā ba le/ ka ta we/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ping ga le/ da ha da ha/ te dzo wa ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i glu len cing gser gyi bum pa spyi bor bkod nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chus dbang bskur/ dri ma dag lus thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ chu rgyun lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ 'khor rnams la rnam par 'joms pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thal mo lhan cig dam du sbyar te pad+ma'i tshul du bgyis pa la mdzub mo nor bur bgyis te gung mo yid tsam bkug pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po'i rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i phyag rgya ste spyi bor gtugs nas dbang bskur ba'i sngags 'di brjod do/

/sarba bid+yaṃ badz+ra badz+ra/ s+pho ṭa ya badz+ra badz+ra/ ka ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma ṭa badz+ra badz+ra/ ma tha badz+ra badz+ra/ aṭ+ṭa hā sa nī la badz+ra/ su badz+ra ya swā hā/ 'dis dbang bskur ba tsam gyis rigs sngags 'chang thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro// bla bre gzhal med khang dang gdugs rgyal mtshan// ba dan phye phur lda ldi mchod pa'i sprin// kun tu snang bas nam mkha'i khams khyab pa'i// lha rdzas mchod yon bzang pos mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bla bre gzhal med khang dang= ba dan phye phur= kun tu snang bas= lha rdzas me tog bzang pos= puṣ+pe= bla bre= ba dan= kun tu= lha rdzas bdug spos bzang pos mchod par bgyi// dhū pe= bla bre= ba dan= kun tu= lha rdzas snang gsal bzang pos mchod par bgyi// ā lo ke= bla bre= ba dan= kun tu= lha rdzas dri chab bzang pos mchod par bgyi// gan+dhe= bla bre= ba dan= kun tu= lha rdzas zhal zas bzang po'i mchod par bgyi/ nai wi d+ya= bla bre= ba dan= kun tu= lha rdzas sil snyan bzang pos mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra shap+ta hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

de nas/ 'dzam bu'i gser las sogs kyis rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ pad can dung ltar sogs kyis bkra shis rtags brgyad 'bul ba'am/ yang na khams lugs phyag rgyun ltar te/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi nā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pra tits+tsha swā hā/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// nor bu rin chen= bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad nas// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sarba= ma ṇi rat+na= btsun mo rin chen= ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad nas// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar/ s+t+ri rat+na= blon po rin chen= phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan phun sum tshogs par shog /pu ru ṣa= glang po rin chen= ltas ngan thams cad rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab zhon nas// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti rat+na= rta mchog rin chen 'di= srid pa'i gzeb las yongs grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /a shwa rat+na= dmag dpon rin chen= nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad nas// snyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /khat+ga rat+na badz+ra= 'dod yon lnga 'bul ba ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badz+ra bi nā ra ṇa sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa ka ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// mos blos= bzhes shig= shap+ta= phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshim byed dri// mos blos=

bzhes shig= gan+dhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos= bzhes shig= rā s+ya= phyogs dus na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed cing*// mos blos= bzhes shig /spar+she= de nas rnal 'byor pa la dgra 'am bgegs yod na gdab las kyi sgo nas mchod par bya ste// dgra lam bgegs gang la bya ba'i ling ga srog yig bla dgas dang bcas pa zag rdzas byug /nya'u dug khrag gis sbag la/ brub khung du bcug rang nyid sgrol gang nag po'i chas gcer bu khrag gis byugs pa 'am/ yang na zhwa dang gos nag gyon rnga dang 'cham stabs su bstun te/ thog mar brub khung bskyed pa ni/ brub khung 'di nyid bh+rūm̐ las gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom/ las kyi gshin rje'i btson khang*/ rngams nag pa/ gting ring ba/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i 'og tu sleb pa/ 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba/ zhe sdang gi me dpung 'bar ba/ gti mug gi mun nag rab tu gtibs pa/ nga rgyal gyi brag gtams pa/ phrag dog gi rlung dmar 'tshub pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bab pa/ dug dang nad thams cad kyi na bun 'thibs pa/ de'i nang du nri las byad ma nag la ham pa/ sngo la rid pa/ shin du nyam thag pa/ gan rkyal du bsgyel ba/ mig shi mig du lta ba/ yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa gcig tu gyur/ na mo// sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po 'di'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag la/ snga dgra lag la bdar cing*/ phyis dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra dngos su byed pa'i gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad skad cig yud cig la dmigs pa'i nya'u 'di la lcags kyu can rnams kyis khug cig

zhags pa can rnams kyi chings shig lcags sgrog can rnams kyis sdoms shig /dril bu can rnams kyis mnyos shig /sarba sha trūn// badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥbadz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+phoṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a/ khugs rtags ma byung bar ram lan gsum du bya/ dmigs pa bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa'i khro bo dpag tu med pa spros pas/ gnod byed byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa rang dbang med par lcags kyus snying khar btab ste drangs/ zhags pas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis bsdams/ dril bus nyed cing rang dbang med par la las rgyab nas ded/ la las mdun nas drangs/ la las steng nas 'jus shing 'gugs pas mdun gyi nya'u la thim par bsam mo/ de nas gu gul/ thang khrom/ khyi nag po'i brun/ rwa gzhob/ yug sa'i khrag gis sbags pa'i lham 'bob dang lnga'i dud pas bdug cing*/ /sarba sha trūn/ pho lha dgra lha mo lha zhang lha yul lha thams cad dang*/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa saṃ gha ṭa/ ces bzla'o// de nas rabs chad nag po'i rus pa'i phye ma/ yungs kar/ ske tshe/ shang tshe/ zangs lcags rdo phye til nag sngar gyi rdzas ngan dug khrag gis byug pa/ drag po'i sngags rgod 'dis ngar blud de/ oṃ tad+ya thā/ tru ṭa tru ṭa/ tro ṭa tro ṭa/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa/ s+pho ṭa ya s+pho ṭa ya/ ghūr+ṇā ghūr+ṇā/ ghūr+ṇā pa ya ghūr+ṇā pa ya/ sarba satwā ni/ bho dha bho dha/ saṃ bho dha ya saṃ bho dha ya/ bh+rā ma bh+rā ma/ saṃ bh+rā ma ya saṃ bh+rā ma ya/ sarba bhū tā ni/ kuṭ+ṭa kuṭ+ṭa/ saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya saṃ kuṭ+ṭa ya/ sa rba shatrūn/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ saṃ gha ṭa ya saṃ gha ṭa ya/ sarba sha trūn mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa'i sham bu btags pas ngar blud la ling ga la brab par bya'o/ /hūm̐// nga ni las kyi khro bo ste// gdug pa can gyi gshed ma yin// yungs kar rgyal po sha rī raṃ// dgra bgegs steng du dbab par bya// khrag 'thung dug rlangs chi li li// mtshe yi mda' 'phen zangs se zangs// gnam lcags thog 'bab hril li li// yungs kar rbab 'dril sha ra ra// phung po gting nas brlag par bya// oṃ tad+ya thā/

tru ṭa sogs sngags gong ltar bgrang zhing thun brdeg /de nas phur pa thogs te/ hūm̐/ phrin las chen po'i dus la bab// rdo rje phur pa ki lā ya// stod ni khro bo 'bar ba'i zhal// 'chang bzung rdo rje glog stong 'khyug /chu srin kha nas 'brug stong ldir// sku smad zur gsum dbal ldan pa// dgra bgegs steng du ki lā ya// skad cig nyid la srog dang phrol// he phu l+lu/ ni ru phul+lu/ gṛ h+na kul+lu/ mi li tsul+lu/ ku ru kul+lu/ badz+ra bi dza yā swā hā/ kī lī kī la ya swā hā/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭa ra ṭa/ mo ṭa na/ pra mo ṭa nā ya swā hā/ tsa ra ni tsa ra/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ mā ra ya/ badz+ra bi dā ṇā ya swā hā/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ ma hā kī li kī la ya swā hā/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ kro dha badz+ra kī la kī lā ya swā hā/ trā sa ya/ tra sa ya/ badz+ra kī li kī lā ya swā hā/ ces phur sngags brjod pas kha dang snying kha/ lte bar brdeg de nas ral gri thogs nas/ hūm̐/ 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i lha tshogs rnams// mngon spyod drag po'i dus la bab// mi bzad rno ba'i mtshon cha yis// lus ni dum bur gtub par bya// dbang po rtsad nas 'byin par bya// rdul phran bzhin du gtor bar bya/ zhes dum bur byas// de nas rdo rje'i tho ba thogs la/ brdungs shig rdo rje tho ba yis// khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du// gdug pa'i yid can dgra bgegs 'di// rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya// rdo rje me dbal snying bsregs nas// lus ngag thal ba'i rdul du rlog ces rdul du btags pa gtso 'khor rnams kyi zhal gdangs par bstabs pas dgyes par bsam ste/ /hūm̐/ khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje shugs// rnam par 'joms mdzad ye shes lha// sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po ste// khams gsum gdug pa'i gshed khyod gson// gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la// gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs// glog stong lta bur ljags rkyong zhig

/dgra bgegs 'di yi las mtha' gtugs// rdul phran bzhin du brlag byas pa'i// srog gzugs kha rje dbang thang rnams// khro rgyal khyod kyi zhal du btab// bzhes shig rol zhig kha raṃ khā hi// sku gsung yon tan 'phrin las kyi// ma rungs tshar gcod gtum po bzhi// sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las pa// nyams pa kun gyi dbugs len gson// gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la// gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs// glog stong lta bur ljags rkyong zhig /dgra bgegs 'di yi las mtha' gtugs// stong 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhugs nas// bgegs rnams kun la gshed 'bebs pa// drag shul chen po mnga' ba khyed// rnal 'byor dgra lha lags kyis gson// gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs la// gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs// glog stong lta bur ljags rkyong zhig /dgra bgegs 'di yi las mtha' gtugs/ zhes brjod nas sngar gyi gtor 'bul gyi sngags/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku laṃ āwarta ya/ mahā ba le/ ka ṭa we/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ping ga le/ da ha da ha/ te dzo wa ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku laṃ āwarta ya/ mahā ba le/ ka ṭa we/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ping ga le/ da ha da ha/ te dzo wa ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ bar dang*/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhañdza nā ya swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhar+m+ma ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+panyan tāt+to oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes 'bul la lhag ma gtor ro// de nas rdo rje'i ri dang zhes sogs sam/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pas bstod par bya ste/ oṃ/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas// mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa// rdo rje 'dzin pa rdo rje'i rgyal// rdo rje sku ste sku che ba// lag na rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje yan lag rdo rje mchog

/rdo rje 'bar ba cher 'bar ba// rdo rje shugs te shugs che la// rdo rje mtshon cha rdo rje mchog /phyag na rdo rje lag chen po// rdo rje mda' ste rab 'big pa// rdo rje rnon po rno ba che// che ba'i che ba rgya mtsho che// rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas che// 'byung ba sangs rgyas rang byung ba// rdo rje rgya chen sgyu 'phrul che// rdo rje sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba// rdo rje rgyu ste gnod sbyin che// rdo rje pad+ma rnam sbyong ba// rdo rje khro bo ma rungs che// rdo rje dgra sdang 'joms pa'i gtso// rdo rje 'jigs pa srung ba che// rdo rje lcags kyu don yod che// rdo rje ro langs tshogs bdag che// rdo rje srin po za byed che// rdo rje gnod sbyin ro langs che// rdo rje go cha gdon gyi mchog /'jigs byed drag byed drag chen po// rdo rje 'jigs byed rngam byed pa// sgrub dka'i sgrub pa legs mdzad pa// rdo rje legs pa dgyes byed pa// rdo rje dga' ba dga' ba che// dga' ba'i rdo rje dbang byed pa// rdo rje gzi brjid gzi brjid che// 'bar 'od gshin rje mthar byed pa// rdo rje drag po drag po che// 'od sdug pa ste sdug pa che// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa po// re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur mchog /rdo rje rgyal mtshan yon tan mtsho// rdo rje ye shes ye shes che// rig sngags bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor// ha la ha la nag po che// sgra chen zhing gi 'joms pa'i gtso// rdo rje 'dod pa 'dod dbang che// snyigs ma'i lus ngan rnam sbyong ba// skad cig g.yo ba'i the tshom gcod// zhal gyi ljags dam glog bzhin 'phro// rdo rje me ste ma rungs 'dul// drag po rab snang mdzad pa yi// nyi ma 'od stong bsdus pa'i zhal// spyan sngar 'jigs par mdzad pa po// khro bo du ma'i 'od tshogs 'phro// phyag na du ma'i mtshon cha brgya// du ma'i zhal gyi sku yang ston// 'khyil zhing brgyan yang 'khyil ba ste// sems kyi chos la sku mi mnga'// rnam par rtog pa ma lus spangs// ma rig 'joms pa'i tshangs pa ste// 'dod chags zhe sdang dri mthar mdzad// sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje can// rtse gsum rtse gsum 'chang 'phrog byed// nyon mongs chags sdang rmongs phrag dog

/srid pa srid min yongs sbyong ba// zhi zhing dal ba dga' ba che// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rtogs byed// sangs rgyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku// rdo rje rab skyes rdo rje sems// kun tu bzang po cher bzang po// mtshan mchog dam pas rab brgyan zhing*// khams gsum bdag nyid khyab pa po// thams cad rdo rje khyab bdag gtso// e ma ho kun tu bzang po yis// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mchog /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus// de bzhin gshegs nyid mdzes la bstod// bcom ldan rdo rje rnam 'joms ni// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// drag po'i phrin las ma lus pa// bsgrub par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ de nas lha rnams kyi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje'i lte bar zla ba la hūm̐ rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor bar bsam la/ de la dmigs nas bzla dus sngags kyi lha mos mchod pa dang*/ sgrib pa sbyang ba dang*/ gdon 'thon pa dang*// dngos grub bsgrub pa'i las bzhi'i spro bsdu bya'o// rgyas par spro na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sbyin sreg gis mchod/ de nas phyi rol du cha gsum gyis 'jig rten pa mchod par yang bya ste/ stegs bu la cha gsum gyi gtor ma dang*/ nyer spyod rnams bshams la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañtsa ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ aṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ las mchod yon me tog/ dri chab/ bdug spos/ zhal zas/ snang gsal/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas thams cad rang bzhin stong pa rnam pa mchod rdzas byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya a warta ya ho/ badz+ra sa s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/

lan gsum/ gtor ma rnams a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ las gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma dang po phyogs skyong rnams la 'bul ba ste/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra e h+ya hi/ spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ gdan phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/

sogs/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams brjod par bya ste/ hūm̐/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs bcas// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*// lha rnams ma lus sa yi klu rnams dang*// ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs 'dus la// so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di bzhes la// rang rang gi ni phyogs su bzhugs nas kyang*// rang gi bu smad grogs dang g.yog 'khor bcas// dpung dang sde bcas mnyes nas bzhes su gsol// spos dang me tog gtor ma zhal zas ni// 'di dag bzhes shing so sor bsnams nas kyang*// bya ba 'di yi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces dang*/ oṃ in+d+ra ye swā hā/ de bzhin oṃ dang swā hā kun la sbyar te/ ag+na ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ra t+ye/ wā ru ṇā ye/ wa ya be/ ku be ra ya/ i sha na ye/ bra h+ma ṇa ye/ sur+ya ye/ tsan+d+ra ye/ pri thi wi/ na ge bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsogs khaṃ swā hā bar lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs gong bzhin mchod/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha// lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs dri za'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me ste sreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de= gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha// ma mo'i rgyal po= lho phyogs gshin rje'i tshogs= mchod cing= bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha// srin po'i rgyal po= lho nub srin po'i= mchod cing= zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha// tshig srung gdon gyi bdag po ste// nub phyogs chu lha'i= mchod cing= rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha// rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi=

nub byang rlung lha'i= mchod cing= gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs// nor srung rgyal po= byang phyogs gnod sbyin= mchod cing= dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha// 'byung po'i rgyal po= byang shar dbang ldan= mchod cing= steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*// nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po// gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la// mchod cing= 'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*// dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs nas/ de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms shing*// dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzod// phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag cag rnams la bgegs med cing las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de ni bgegs nye bar zhi ba'i don to/ cha gcig gdon rnams tshim par bya ba'i phyir te/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod par bya'o/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bdag cag pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni// thal sbyar khyed rnams la yang gsol 'debs na// bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa rnams// gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir spyon cig /oṃ dā+e wa/ nā ga/ yak+sha sa/ gan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ṭa/ keṃ na ra/ ma ho ra ga/ ma nu ṣe/ a ma nu ṣe/ e h+ye hi/ spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ gdan 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐/ puṣ+pe nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ dā+e ba sogs gong ltar gyi/ a ma nu ṣe/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa sogs khaṃ swā hā lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs gong ltar gyis mchod/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yul kun gnas dang*// shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*// grong khyer kun na gang dag gnas pa dang*// chu bo kun dang chu yi mdo rnams dang*// rin chen gnas na lhag par gang gnas dang*// rdzing dang mtsho dang lu ma lteng ka dang*// khron pa dang ni ngam grog chu mig dang*// grong dang phyugs lhas dang ni nags tshal dang*// khang stong dang ni lha yi khang pa dang*// gang dag gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas// bsod nams khyim dang glang po'i khang rnams dang*// gang dag rgyal po'i dkor khang gnas pa dang*// srang dang khyams dang grong gi 'dun sa dang*// gang dag shing gcig drung dang lam chen gnas// dur khrod dang ni nags tshal cher gnas dang*// seṅge glang chen dred kyi gnas rnams dang*// gang dag 'jigs rung dgon par cher gnas dang*// chu gling mchog dag tu ni gnas byas dang*// gang dag 'brog dgon dur khrod dag na gnas// dga' zhing mgu nas dri ma me tog phreng*// spos dang me tog mar me gus phul ba// 'di dag bsnams te so sor bzhes nas kyang*// las 'di dag gi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/

sde brgyad 'byung po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bdag cag gi 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba'i sdong grogs mdzod cig de ni gdon rnams tshim pa'i phyir ro/ cha gcig bgegs la bsngo ba ste/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi= gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ lha'i tshogs rnams kyi= bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag cag rnams la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig yud cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cig /oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas bkug /oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ sarba bigha nan na ma sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs khaṃ swā hā bar lan gsum gyis bsngos/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs gong ltar gyis mchod/ de nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di brjod de/ hūm̐/ gang dag mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa// de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phug dang*// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang por bcas// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid /de ring phan chad bskyed par gyis// rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*// dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod// 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste// dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de// mtshon chas mi 'jig gang yang med// 'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzems// 'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du// rang gi lus la dpe longs la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis// lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i// nad de nye bar phyungs nas kyang*// gdon de rab tu zhi bar mdzod// de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyi// mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yi// dam tshig la ni gnas nas su// bdag gi bsam pa skong bar mdzod// rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*// de ring rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi// nad de rab tu sol mdzod la// gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs// oṃ sarba bhu ta gats+tsha/

bgegs gtor dor/ oṃ dā+e ba/ na ga/ yak+sha sa/ gan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ṭa/ keṃ na ra/ ma ho ra ga/ ma nu ṣe/ a ma nu ṣe/ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gats+tsha/ zhes gdon rnams gshegs/ oṃ in+d+ra ya/ ag+na ye/ ya ma ye/ ni ra t+ye/ wā ru ṇā ye/ wa ya be/ ku be ra ya/ i sha na ye/ bra h+ma ṇa ye/ sur+ya ye/ tsan+d+ra ye/ pri thi wi/ na ge bh+yaḥ a su re bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gats+tsha/ ces phyogs skyong rnams gshegs/ nye reg byas la nang du log ༈ de nas bdag 'jug ni/ ji skad 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bla ma'i bya ba gtso bos dang*/ slob ma'i rnams rang gis byas par mos la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ bar gyis khrus bya/ de nas oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i drung du dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o sogs/ nir+ya t+ya mi bar gyis maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni bzhugs par 'tshal/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'das pa dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bo'i byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med de// ston pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang 'di yis bcom/ zhes spro ba bskyed/ rtogs pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje 'dzin sogs kyi// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlobs/

zhes nyan par gdams/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog bar gyi bdun rnam dag gi byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis bskyed/ de nas oṃ a mṛ ta sogs kyis slob ma bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa/ sku mdog mthing nag /drag shul chen po'i byin gyis sgeg pa/ gsus khyim che zhing*/ nywa sul rags pa/ gnam sa tsam du gdangs pa'i khro bo'i zhal nas/ khams gsum za bar byed pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags bsgril nas rkan sgra brdabs pas srid pa gsum g.yo zhing bsgul ba/ ag tshom mer dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i khrod nas rdo rje'i me stag 'phro ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung 'tshub cing smin ma 'khyogs po las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/ dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ rdo rje'i thod nyis rim du bcings pa'i ral pa dmar ser gyen du gzings pa rta gdong gi ri langs pa lta bu/ phyag g.yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyi rdo rje ma rungs pa'i snying la gsor zhing*/ g.yon 'gying bag dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ sbrul chen po rigs lngas rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang se ral kha dang do shal dang*/ gdub bu byas pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs kyis smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i brjid kyis nyin mor byed pa brdzis te sku las mched pa'i me dang mi bzad pa'i du ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gyis lhar bskyed la/ dri'i chus gnas gsum du reg cing*/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ spyi bor oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po/ snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar 'ching*/

'jug pa'i phyir/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa kye// gtso bo 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol// mi shes mun gyis bsgribs pa la// dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ bla mas/ /lam chen 'di ni bstan par bya// khyod kyis lam 'di bsgrub par gyis// lam mchog bsgrub la rab tu dga'// nyes pa dag gis ma gos par// 'bras bu myur du 'byin par byed// dam tshig 'das na dmyal bar ltung*// na mo rat+na tra yā ya// na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya na ra kan hūm̐/ zhes mna' chu sbyin/ de nas lha mo'i glu/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku laṃ āwarta ya/ mahā ba le/ ka ṭa we/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ping ga le/ da ha da ha/ te dzo wa ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wā lā ya swā hā/ dzab tu 'then zhing dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor bar bsam/ lag pa gnyis khong stong du sbyar la srin lag gnyis nang du bcug ste phan tshun bsnol ba'i rtse mo mdzub mo'i drung du cung zad dbyung bar byas nas gung mo'i tshigs phyi rol nas mdzub mo gnyis bkug la bar nas gang tsam ma reg par byas te/ mthe bong gnyis dang mthe chung gnyis gzhibs pa rnam par 'joms pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor gzhag nas gzungs ring gcig dang*/ gzungs thung gnyis bzlas/ rol mo'i sgra dang sngags kyis btab pa'i yungs kar dang gu gul gyi dud pas bdug go/ des lha'i rigs kyi bsod nams ci 'dra ba de bzhin du 'bab par 'gyur ro// des dkyil 'khor dbang du 'gyur la/ de nas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma'i steng du 'dug la me tog gi 'phreng ba/ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ hūm̐ pu dza hoḥ zhes dkyil 'khor du dor bar bya'o// gtso bo la rdo rje'i rigs/ shar du sku sogs/ dbu la mchog

/sked pa la thun mong*/ rkang pa la phog na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro// gal te ma babs shing me tog phyir lhung na spogs pa'i cho ga bya ste phyis dbang bskur bar bya'o/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar dkrol/ bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa bgyis par gyur pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas byang bar 'gyur bas so// rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum gyis mthong bar bsam/ de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi bdag po che// cis kyang mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i// rdo rje'i dbang bskur stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas pa'i ku sha 'am stan gsar pa la bzhag /a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bdag nyid mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ nag po yongs su gyur pa las khro bo'i rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa mthing shun dri ma med pa'i kha dog lta bu lte bar zla ba la gzungs sngags kyi yi ge hraṃ mer snang ba/ yi ge'i lha'o/ /de las rnam par 'joms pa'i sku sna la bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyi sprin nam mkha' khyab par gang bas 'phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad/ 'phags pa rnams mchod cing nus mthu bsdus te zla ba sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag /drag shul chen po'i byin gyis sgeg pa/ gsus khyim che zhing*/ nywa sul rags pa/ gnam sa tsam du gdangs pa'i khro bo'i zhal nas/ khams gsum za bar byed pa'i mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags bsgril nas rkan sgra brdabs pas srid pa gsum g.yo zhing bsgul ba/ ag tshom mer dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar ba'i khrod nas rdo rje'i me stag 'phro ba/ khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas dus mtha'i rlung 'tshub cing smin ma 'khyogs po las bskal pa'i me 'bar ba/

dmar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ rdo rje'i thod nyis rim du bcings pa'i ral pa dmar ser gyen du gzings pa rta gdong gi ri langs pa lta bu/ phyag g.yas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mthu stobs kyi rdo rje ma rungs pa'i snying la gsor zhing*/ g.yon 'gying bag dang bcas pas dril bu dkur brten pa/ sbrul chen po rigs lngas rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang se ral kha dang do shal dang*/ gdub byas pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi pags pa rlon pa'i sham thabs kyis smad dkris pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i brjid kyis nyin mor byed pa brdzis te sku las mched pa'i me dang mi bzad pa'i du ba 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ shru tis+thi ra badz+ra oṃ/ spyi bor pad+ma'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/

rdo rje thal mo la mdzub mo'i rtse sbyar ba pad+ma'i phyag rgya mgrin pa ra gtugs te/ pra tis+thi ra badz+ra āḥ mgrin par nyi ma'i steng du pad+ma dmar po āḥmatshan pa/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya snying khar gtugs te/ ma tis+thi ra badz+ra hūm̐/ snying khar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje mthing kha lte bar zla ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i phyag rgyas skye mched rnams la reg cing*/ mahā badz+ra/ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ e h+ye hi badz+ra/ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra/ zhes brjod pas/ mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus la zla ba la rdo rje/ dkyil 'khor gyi sngags bzlas pa'i gdugs ba dan rgyal mtshan rol mo dang gnod mdzes kyi sngags bzlas pa'i bdug spos kyis bdug cing bum pa spyan drangs te/ dkyil 'khor la lan gsum/ na ma saman+ta badz+ra naṃ sogs aṅku sha dz+wa la ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar gyis lha mo'i glu'i 'dzab dbyangs dang bcas te bskor ba byas nas/ shar gyi bum pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ bum pa bzang po dag byed chus gang ba// glu sgra rol mor ldan pas dbang bskur bas// lus kyi sgrib sbyangs zhe sdang rnam dag pas// me long lta bu'i ye shes rtogs par shog /na mañtsan+d+ra badz+ra abhi ṣi ñtsa oṃ/ nub kyi bum pa mgrin par bzhag nas/ bum pa bzang po= glu sgra rol mo= ngag gi sgrib sbyangs 'dod chags rnam dag pas// so sor rtog pa'i ye shes rtogs par shog /na mañtsan+d+ra badz+ra abhi ṣi ñtsa hrī/ dbus kyi bum pa snying khar bzhag nas/ /bum pa bzang po= glu sgra rol mo= yid kyi sgrib sbyangs gti mug rnam dag pas// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rtogs par shog /na mañtsan+d+ra badz+ra abhi ṣi ñtsa hūm̐// lho'i bum pa lte bar bzhag nas/ bum pa bzang po= glu sgra rol mo= /nyon yid sgrib sbyangs nga rgyal rnam dag pas// mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rtogs par shog /na mañtsan+d+ra badz+ra abhi ṣi ñtsa trāṃ/ byang gi bum pa gsang gnas su bzhag nas/

bum pa bzang po= glu sgra rol mo= sgo lnga'i sgrib sbyangs phrag dog rnam dag pas// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rtogs par shog /na mañtsan+d+ra badz+ra abhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rdo rje nyis rim gyi 'phreng ba spyi bor bcings nas/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa// rnam sbyong dri ma sel mdzad cing*// thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des// khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ 'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams// thar pa'i lam du 'dren mdzad cing*// chos rnams thams cad ston pa des// khyed la= ston pa bzhugs pa rnams kyi rten// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gang gi bde ba mnga' mdzad des// khyed la= skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yis// thugs bskyed 'gro ba 'di dag kun// bu gcig bzhin du rtag skyong des// khyed la= gang zhig 'khor bar 'khor ba yis// sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*// gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des// khyed la= gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur// gtsang zhing bslu ba mi mnga' ba// gsung gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des// khyed la= dpa' bo chen po gang skyes par// phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cig /don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des// khyed la= gang zhig skyes pa'i sa rnams dang*// nags tshal bcas par rab g.yos shing*// sems can thams cad rab dga' byed// khyed la= byang chub snying por gshegs pa na// sa dag rnam drug g.yo byed cing*// bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des// khyed la= chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na// 'phags pa'i bden pa rab gsungs shing*// thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des// khyed la= yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed// thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*// chos kun dbang du mdzad pa des// khyed la= sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad// brgya byin gtsang ma'i lha rnams dang*// 'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni// khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*// lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis// khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa// don de de ring 'grub gyur cig

/rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gror bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// khyed cag kun tu bde legs gyur// khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig ces bkra shis brjod// sgom pa'i dbang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas/ /rdo rje khro bo las byung ba'i// rdo rje snying po 'di nyid du// khams gsum srid pa bsgyur ba'i phyir// bsgom zhing grub pa'i dbang sbyin no/ bzlas pa'i dbang ni/ gzungs sngags 'gi'u wang ngam gur gyis bris pa'i 'dzab byang gtad de/ /gang zhig las dang rnam smin mkhyen pa yis// 'gro ba kun dang ji ltar mthun par ni// gsang sngags gzugs kyi rjes su 'jug mdzad pa// sngags kyi rnam 'dren de yi dbang bskur ro// rig pa gtad pa'i dbang ni/ yid kyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon rnam par 'joms par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i zla ba sngags phreng las sngags kyi phreng ba mched de zhal nas 'thon/ rang nyid rnam 'joms su gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs te/ snying kha'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar 'khod par bsam te gzungs sngags tshang ma lan gsum re bzla/ de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la bsnyen pa dang*// 'di la rab tu 'go bar mdzod// slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod do// de nas slob dpon kyi dbang sbyin pa'i phyir/ rang nyid seng ge'i khri pad+ma'i snying po can la 'khod cing steng du gdugs kyis phub pa'i 'og tu gnas pa la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ lag pa g.yas su rdo rje dang*/ g.yon du gser gyi 'khor lo bzhag nas/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis//

bsgrub par bya ba'i dbang ni// gtso bo la sogs pa'i sku 'am// phur bu gang rung rim ba bzhin gtad de/ /mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas// rdo rje khro bo bcom ldan gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du// skal ldan bu khyod dbang bskur ro// zhes gtso bo dang*/ zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// phrin las bzhi yis gdug pa can// 'dul mdzad khro bo rigs bzhi ru// skal ldan bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ rigs bzhi'o/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad du// drag shul chen po'i mthu stobs kyis// gnod byed 'joms mdzad khro bo bcus// skal ldan bu khyod dbang bskur ro// zhes khro bo bcu'o// sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang ni/ lag par rdo rje gtad la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// phyag na rdo rje'i lag tu gtad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs bstan/ 'phrul 'khor gyi las rab 'byams la dbang ba'i phyir rak+ṣa'i 'phreng ba gtad nas/ /sku dang ye shes mi 'bral ba'i/ rig sngags rgyal po mthu chen pos// tshar bcad rjes su 'dzin pa la// dbang bar bya phyir 'phreng ba gzung*/ sbyin sreg dbang ni/ dgang gzar blug byin nas/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*// bsad dang bskrad pa de dag gi /las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis/ bsgral ba gdab las kyi dbang ni/ gdab phur lag tu bsgril zhing liṅga la btab ste/ rdo rje phur bu 'bar ba ni// rab tu bsgril zhing gsor byas nas// lus ngag yid gsum la btab nas// dgra bo sgrol bar dbang bskur ro/ mngon spyod drag po'i mthu dbang ni/ brub khung*/ thod pa/ sbra tshal/ srung skud/ la cha rnams gtad de/ hūm̐/ brub khung 'bar ba'i nang du ni// dgra bo dgug dbye bsad pa dang*// mtshan ngan thod par mnan sogs kyis// mngon spyod mthu yis dbang bskur ro//

de nas sa gzhi spos chus sogs kyi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/ sogs gtang rag gi yon phul/ de nas gtor ma oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces bsangs/ na mo badz+ra kro dha/ mahā ba la ha na da hā pa tsa bidh+wa na sa ya u tsuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsrung*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas nam mkha' khyab par spel/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ sam+bha raṃ sam+bha raṃ swā hā/ ces mgron so so'i yid dang mthun pa'i gtor rdzas su sbar ro// de nas snying kha'i 'od kyis rnam par 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'i mgron ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs pa la/ na maḥs man+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ sarba badz+ra ku laṃ āwarta ya/ mahā ba le/ ka ta we/ ta ta le/ a tsa le/ maṇ+ḍa la mā ye/ a ti badz+ra/ ma hā ba le/ be ga ra ṇa ra ṇa/ a dzi te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ti ṭi ti ṭi/ ping ga le/ da ha da ha/ te dzo wa ti/ ti li ti li/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma hā ba le/ badz+ra aṅku sha dz+wā lā ya swā hā// ces sngar gyi lha mo'i glu'i mthar/ ha ra ha ra/ badz+ra dha rā ya swā hā/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ badz+ra pra bhañdza nā ya swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhar+m+ma ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+panyan tāt+to oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis phul/ /sangs rgyas kun kyi sku gsung thugs// gdug pa tshar gcod khro bo'i sku// rdo rje chen po 'jigs chen po// rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces sam bstod pa rgyas pa'i mthar/ tshangs pa brgya byin me yi lha// gshin rje srin po chu yi bdag /rlung lha gnod sbyin bgegs kyi rgyal// sa bdag la sogs phyogs skyong bcu// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang*// mkha' lding 'dab bzang lus srul po// mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye che// sde brgyad tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// sa chu me rlung nam mkha' la// gnas pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag tshogs// so so rang gis 'khor 'dul zhing*// sa gnas rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/mgon po thugs rje 'chang ba po// rig sngags rgyal po dge ba can// gnod pa thams cad zhi ba'i phyir// mgon po khyod kyis byin gyis rlobs/

zhes 'dod don gsol nas/ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal/ sgrub chen gyi cho ga ste nub gsum pa'o/ de nas rjes kyi cho ga ni/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ puṣ+pe nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// gdug pa tshar gcod khro ba'i sku// rdo rje chen po 'jigs chen po// rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rdul tshon yin na nyin snga ma rnams la/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ sogs/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod/ nyin mtha' mar/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyis gshegs/ dam tshig sems dpa' stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ rdul tshon gyi lha yin na chu bor drangs ngo*/ ras bris yin na/ 'dir na gzugs dang lhan gcig tu/ sogs brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas bdag bskyed bsdu ba ni/ mthar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yud tsam zhig dmigs/ de rnams rnam par 'joms pa gsal ba la de snying ga'i yig 'bru/ de sgra tsam/ de yal ba'i chos dbyings su bzhag /de las bdag gi de kho na nyid/ de las rnam smin gyi lus su ldang bar gyur/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje rnam 'joms 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog / sgrub mchod sogs kyi tshe nyin gyi rigs sta gon 'degs pa bzhin du byas nas/ slar phyag rgyal dogs pa ba 'bebs pa yang shes par bya'o// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa khro bo'i bsnyen sgrub sgrub chen gyi yi ge 'di yang*/ lha 'di nyid la drod thob pa'i rigs sngags 'chang chos grags bstan pa rab 'phel gyis ring mo nas bskur ba ltar du// dza ba ri pa dang dzā ya warma'i gzhung ji lta ba bla ma'i zhal skyin gyi rjes su 'brangs pa/

rje btsun yon tan ye shes kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor thob pa pad+ma dkar pos yul dbus grwa dar lung gi ri khrod du sbyar ba bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig slad nas sgrub mchod dang dbang bskur sogs la 'jug pa bde ba'i slad ngag 'don chu 'babs su ngag dbang mthu stobs tshul khrims bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos khams lugs kyi gsung rgyun gzhir bzung nas bkod pa'i dge bas 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mchog la 'god pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// /
